results.actual: Production v38 created a confirmed relation with version history, pinned citation, knowledge records, note, project membership and redeemed source access.
After the real v39 schema fault, the exact v38 schema, 38 ledger rows and every pre-existing table were unchanged.
Two successful opens produced one correct v39 ledger record, with prior relation, knowledge and citation projections intact.
Faults at the attempt insert and after that insert left both tables unchanged; the official learner projection returned no feedback or attempted answer.
The same request key succeeded after rollback, returned the stored first answer and pinned feedback, replayed without changes and rejected a changed payload and stale sequence.

Two worker connections started from sequence 1. One stored the follow-up with a matching receipt, the other hit a sequence conflict and left no row. The first answer and all v38 data remained unchanged.
A new storage instance read the same owning user history; the author could not read it and rows and ledger were unchanged.
